exposure: indication for assisted vaginal delivery (fetal distress, protracted second stage of labor)
cohort: Primiparous women who delivered at Haukeland University Hospital, Bergen, Norway, between June 2021 and April 2023.
finding: Forceps delivery was associated with a higher prevalence of levator ani muscle (LAM) avulsion compared to vacuum delivery and spontaneous vaginal delivery, with the odds being 3-fold higher for forceps when the indication was protracted second stage of labor, but not significantly different when the indication was fetal distress.
mod_finding: Comparing modes of birth, forceps delivery was associated with a higher prevalence of LAM avulsion but a lower risk of neonatal trauma compared with vacuum delivery.
